TattooMagic.TattooMagicDef.label: Phoenix
TattooMagic.TattooMagicDef.description: A rare tattoo that cheats death itself. Its wearer automatically returns to life some time after actually dying, at the cost of a burn and a growing risk of temporary paralysis — and passively guards against fatal bleeding along the way. Revival only prevents death itself: any lasting damage from the killing blow, such as a mangled organ, comes back with the wearer rather than being healed.
TattooMagic.TattooMagicDef.modifierSummary: Tier 1: revives 5 days after death (decomposition-based chance, retries daily); severe burn per attempt; passive chance to auto-cauterize a severe bleed. Tier 2 (reached by staying alive long enough): revives after only 3 days; lighter burn per attempt; higher cauterize chance. Only 3 may be active across your whole faction at once.
